title: Did the 1995 PlayStation Really Ship 100 Million Units?

scenes.text: The 1995 PlayStation sold over 100 million copies worldwide—true or myth?
Many believe the original PlayStation instantly hit 100 million sales right after launch.
scenes.label: Instant 100M sales myth

scenes.text: The PlayStation reached 100 million cumulative sales in 2005, ten years after its debut, after strong support from later titles and the PS2 launch.
scenes.label: Reached 100M in 2005

scenes.text: Patience paid off—long‑term success beats early hype.
scenes.label: Long‑term success
scenes.sub: It took a decade, not months, to hit 100 M.
